notes: A security release: the OIDC callback now binds every SSO flow to the browser that started it (GHSA-5gx8-3hch-6m2f), closing an account-linking CSRF that could hand a logged-in victim's account, admin included, to an attacker through their own IdP identity. Instances with SSO configured should update promptly. Also fixes Rich-preview Open Graph truncation at apostrophes and hardens the og-image fetch against private/internal hosts and redirect tricks.
